roads.name: Lucky Strike Trail
words: Curve after curve after curve: 25 in 2.5 miles, about 10 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 8,071 to 8,662 ft, with 857 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 75°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.27 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Scenic Drive
words: Properly twisty: 56 curves in 9.4 miles, about 6 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 3,670 to 4,782 ft, with 2,431 ft of up and down along the way.
11 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 94°F.
